subject: literacy
concept: Reading a small set of common irregular ('sight') words that don't follow standard phonics rules
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading high-frequency word sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches physical word cards to the correct spoken word
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the correct sight word among similar-looking distractors
exercise.abstract: Student reads sight words aloud from a short list with automaticity

misconception_flags: tries to sound out irregular words phonetically instead of recognizing them by sight

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
